Dutch weblog http://geenstijl.nl is trying to get a referendum organised on EU expansion and they are well on their way to make it happen.. A new Dutch law makes it possible to request a referendum on any law that has been passed but which hasn't been activated yet. But in order to actually get a referendum several hurdles have to be taken: first 10.000 signatures need to be collected on paper and sent by paper mail to a government commission, within four weeks of the initial request. If that works, 300.000 more signatures have to be collected and delivered within six weeks.

The process seems designed to make it as hard as possible, but this Dutch blog is mobilizing everything they have and they passed the first hurdle (10.000 signatures) and are now at 65.000 signatures into the second phase after only a week. If you are Dutch, you can sign online here: http://teken.geenpeil.nl
